prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Link & Save Your Pet", "Your pets and settings are tied directly to your selected sign-in account.", "Permanent Pet Cloud Sync Enabled"]
1: ["Choose & Verify Your Companion", "Ensure bright lighting and clear faces for best custom pet results."]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet Workspace", "Rendering your pet background asset and assembling desktop overlay components."]
3: ["Welcome Your Desktop Companion!", "Quick key combinations and system tray options keep your pet responsive.", "Right-click pet to open actions; System tray icon hides pet"]
4: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Journey", "Choose a pre-made pet or start custom pet creation."]
5: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Complete your adoption to unlock starter desktop treats!", "Starter Desktop Treats Included"]
6: ["Taking longer than usual? Click here to reload login providers."]
7: ["We will pop up a desktop notification when your pet arrives on screen."]
8: []
9: ["Desktop Pet Controls & System Tray", "Your pet lives on your desktop screen! Control visibility and interaction via the system tray icon."]

verdicts.problem: asks for personal information (user face image)
